Counterparty: Meridian Energy Partners LLC
Effective: 2 February 2024

## 14. Change of control

The provider may terminate this agreement upon a change of control of Meridian Energy Partners LLC.

selection_rationale: Change-of-control section states whether counterparty must obtain provider consent (or give notice) upon a change of control.
known_missing_information: Section 14 grants termination right rather than consent/notice.
